entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. A tiny fully clothed human silhouette trapped inside a large clear faceted gemstone, thick dark crystal edges and small suspended figure clearly visible. Single miniature prison form, not a corpse, no chains.
